name: B10-0488/2026 (ECR) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's airports, oil sites and on ships in the Red Sea. It asks the Houthis to stop all attacks and urges Iran to stop arming them. It calls on the European Union to strengthen its naval mission protecting shipping in the Red Sea, to work with partners to calm the region, and to build a closer partnership with Saudi Arabia. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks for more naval ships, diplomacy and a closer partnership with Saudi Arabia.
- **Who it affects:** People in Saudi Arabia and Yemen, shipping crews, and European households facing higher energy and food prices.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and Saudi and Yemeni authorities; decisions on ships and partnerships rest with them.
